Its one weak point is the "clashing with the sales director's request" line. The source doesn't say a December cut-over would clash with the training ban, though the inference is reasonable. It also drops the duplicate-records issue (1.4% of records, about 3,100 failed, medium risk) and the sales training availability risk, both of which a manager would want to know. It is concise, well under 120 words, and well organised. The omissions keep it from a top score.
